Pemanggilan Budi Arie Setiadi dan mantan ajudan Presiden ke-7 RI Joko Widodo, Devid Agus Yunanto, dalam kasus dugaan makar memicu berbagai spekulasi. Pengembangan kasus yang sebelumnya menjerat mantan Kapolri LSP dan lima perwira lainnya kini turut menyoroti sejumlah sosok di lingkaran dekat Jokowi.

Berbagai pandangan muncul mengenai arah penyidikan, mulai dari isu kurir Boyolali, dugaan aliran hasil penyadapan hingga ke Solo, hingga kemungkinan keterlibatan pihak lain. Di sisi lain, muncul kekhawatiran adanya penggiringan opini publik yang mengaitkan kasus tersebut dengan Jokowi.

Perdebatan ini turut menyoroti pentingnya pembuktian dalam mengungkap keterkaitan para pihak dengan kasus dugaan makar. Di tengah berbagai spekulasi dan pertarungan narasi politik, publik menantikan hasil penyidikan kepolisian untuk mengungkap fakta serta menjawab berbagai pertanyaan yang berkembang.

The Batman strategy on Bitcoin options, explained in Hindi. I first showed Batman on Nifty; here I build the same setup on Bitcoin with the December monthly expiry on Cosmic. Batman is two ratio spreads, one on the put side and one on the call side. After the crash, Bitcoin options give a very wide range (breakevens about 44,000 and 72,000) and some profit even in the flat centre, which is where the market usually ends. I also show why I think Bitcoin is stuck for now (liquidation levels, the heatmap and Fear & Greed), and how I manage the trade with one take profit and stop loss.

📌 THE SETUP FROM THE VIDEO (BTC options, December monthly expiry, about 33 days left at entry)
• Put side: sell 2 × 49,000 put (about $1,000 each), buy 1 × 52,000 put (about $1,454)
• Call side: sell 2 × 69,000 call (about $1,900 for both), buy 1 call closer to the price (about $1,376)
• Keep some credit on each side; do not spend all of it on the bought leg
• Breakevens at expiry: about 44,000 and 72,000
• Entry window for December: about 20 November to 5 December
• Stop loss = 2 × the centre credit. Example with $100 margin (20 lots): TP about $22, SL about $44, both set in the Cosmic portfolio
• No firefighting: in crypto, buying an extra hedge leg is costly, so I use TP and SL instead of adjustments
This is my personal setup, shown for learning. It is not a recommendation. A ratio spread has an extra short option on each side, so the loss beyond the breakevens can be large. Learn first, start small, and size the trade so that a full stop loss does not hurt you.
